global: This is Chabuton ramen, featuring a rich, amber broth with a perfectly arranged chashu pork slice at center. Garnished with green onions and sesame seeds, it sits in a branded white bowl on a dark wooden table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections, showing natural texture and warm tone.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with black "CHABUTON" text and decorative lines on rim, speckled with sesame seeds.
regions.soup: The miso broth is golden-brown, glossy, and swirling around noodles, topped with sesame seeds, green onions, and a pink pork slice.
regions.meat: The chashu pork displays a spiral shape with pinkish-red meat, white fat marbling, and a slightly crisped, golden-brown outer surface.
